versions.status: sourced from NSE circulars; scope is non-ETF securities in series EQ, BE and BZ only; excludes Gold and other ETFs, SME (SM/ST/SZ), debt, close-ended mutual fund, InvIT and REIT series; effective_from is the start of the Phase 62 research window, not the date the regime began (the flat tick is documented from 2020-05-27); the flat Rs 0.05 is stated in the 2020, 2023 and 2024 consolidated circulars and in NSE/CMTR/62174, and no circular in the NSE CMTR feed from 2021-01-01 to 2024-05-24 revises it
versions.reference_price_rule: not used: one flat tick for every price, so any positive reference price resolves to the same band

versions.status: sourced from NSE circulars; scope is non-ETF securities in series EQ, BE, BZ, BO, RL, AF and their BL series (T0 follows the same tick as its T+1 series); excludes ETFs; below Rs 250 is Rs 0.01 and Rs 250 or more is the regular Rs 0.05
versions.reference_price_rule: closing price on the last trading day of the previous month, reviewed monthly and applied from the first trading day of the next month; the first determination used the 2024-05-31 close for 2024-06-10; a new listing uses the issue price or the last close three trading days before listing; after a split, bonus, dividend or rights issue the existing tick stands until the next monthly review; the caller supplies this price
